cover_letter.greeting: Dear Chase Auto Strategic Business Management Team,
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Senior Associate role in Strategy & Business Management for Chase Auto Commercial Solutions. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli in New York, and before school I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. What drew me to this role is that it sits between strategy and execution for a dealer business that already reaches most U.S. franchised dealers, so the analysis turns into real decisions quickly.

At Lenovo I defined audience segmentation strategies and turned stakeholder needs into dashboards that improved campaign ROI by 20%, and I built forecasts and scenario models that improved capital efficiency by 15%. At JPMorgan I worked on budget allocation across marketing channels, benchmarking past allocations against peers to find 30% efficiency gains, and I turned that analysis into executive-level reporting for senior leadership.

Segmentation and incentive analysis, competitive research and senior-leadership decks are the parts of this role I've already done in some form, and I'd bring that to the Commercial Solutions agenda. I work well across product, finance and marketing teams and I'm comfortable owning a project from scoping to the final readout. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
